description: This file provides provider-specific adapter functions for the LiteLLM framework, including model parsing and parameter transformation functions specific to providers like OpenAI. It handles extracting provider names from model strings and applying necessary parameter patches to maintain compatibility across different LLM providers.

methods.name: str get_provider_from_model(model: str)
methods.description: Extracts the provider name from a model string formatted as 'provider/model-name'. Returns 'unknown' if the format doesn't match.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] apply_openai_patches(params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies OpenAI-specific parameter patches, such as renaming 'max_tokens' to 'max_completion_tokens'.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] apply_provider_patches(params: Dict[str, Any], model: str)
methods.description: Main entry point for applying provider-specific patches based on the model string. Calls specific patch functions for recognized providers.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] filter_none_values(params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Removes key-value pairs with None values from the parameters dictionary.

ctags.name: apply_provider_patches
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_provider_patches(params: Dict[str, Any], model: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
